source_text: Κρεῖσσονὑπαίθριος πίστις πολυτελοῦς εὐσεβείας, καὶ τρεῖς συνηγμένοι ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου πολλῶν ἀρνουμένων θεότητα.
orientation: The author continues his maxims by contrasting simple, open-air faith with expensive piety and three gathered in the Lord's name with many who deny the divinity.
pass_a_gloss: Better is open-air faith than costly piety, and three gathered in the name of the Lord than many denying the divinity.

choices.why: Keeps the literal spatial sense of faith exercised in the open air, matching the brief's contrast with costly religion.
Uses the glossary term 'piety' for εὐσέβεια and renders πολυτελοῦς literally as 'costly' to preserve the contrast.
Literal rendering of the perfect participle, preserving the completed gathering implied by the form.

choices.english: in the name of the Lord
choices.why: Standard literal rendering, matching the allusion to Matthew 18:20 noted in the brief.
Uses the glossary term 'divinity' for θεότης and keeps the present participle's ongoing force.

pass_b_english: Open-air faith is better than costly piety, and three gathered in the name of the Lord are better than many who deny the divinity (Matthew 18:20).
